_설명: 부킹 대화 데이터입니다. 문장·점수·반응을 고치거나 추가한 뒤 새로고침하면 반영됩니다.
open/topics: 선택지 t=말풍선 문구, s=성격별 점수(수줍/활발/장난꾸러기/시크). 점수 합이 booking.threshold 이상이면 합석 성공
reaction1/reaction2: 성격별 NPC 반응(good≥2점, mid 0~1점, bad<0점) · chats: 합석 후 대화(like=좋아하는 성격, r=좋아할 때 NPC 답변)
fallback: LLM 미설정/오류 시 로컬 대사 엔진이 쓰는 성격별 반응. {topic}=감지된 관심사, {name}=NPC 이름. 페르소나의 lines 가 있으면 그것을 우선 사용

Excuse me, want to do a booking? 🍻

playful.good: Oh, smooth? This could be fun haha

How did you end up here tonight?

Jeju Island, no question! Let's go together~
Haha, if we watch together, I'll hold your hand.
Oh, I can never watch them!
I make the world's best ramyeon.

Isn't this situation kind of funny?

greet: Hi~ nice to meet you! Great vibe tonight, right?
like: You like {topic}? No way, me too!
dislike: Hmm… not that topic~ let's talk about something else!
Aw~ not that kind of talk haha
compliment: Oh, come on~ but it's nice to hear haha
Really? I made an effort tonight!
joke: Oh that's so funny haha, are you a comedian?
question: Hmm~ that's hard to answer in one word! What about you?
Oh, I was curious about that too. What do you think?
boring: Aw~ that's it? Bring more energy!
Hmm~ your reactions are too short!
rude: Wow… that's not okay. I'm disappointed.
That's not something you say. I'm leaving.
pushy: Whoa~ that's too fast! Here, only a virtual Instagram instead of contacts haha
tease: Huh? Thought I'd fall for you already? Not yet~
Haha, don't think I'm that easy~
generic: I see~ I totally get it haha
Wow, that's fun! So what happened?
leave: I'm going back to my friends~ That was fun!
ending: Tonight was so much fun! Want to swap Instagrams? (virtual) 💌
